## Character production workflow

The seven-stage Athena-inspired case preserves one character from visual research through directions, controlled outfit and physique variants, final design, modeling/rigging views, a neutral white-model reference, and interactive review of the Tripo AI GLB. The page includes a copyable workflow prompt, stage prompts, acceptance gates, and required user approvals.

## Evidence boundary

The completed Athena stages come from one continuous image-generation run. Pending stages are not represented by unrelated archive images. White-model images are modeling references, not actual topology, rigged meshes, or engine-ready assets.
